nodes.summary: For every natural number $s \ge 3$, $p_s(4) = 6s - 8$, where $p_s(n)$ is the $n$-th $s$-gonal number.
nodes.title: Polygonal numbers at four

nodes.summary: For every natural number $s \ge 3$, $p_s(3) = 3s - 3$, where $p_s(n)$ is the $n$-th $s$-gonal number.
nodes.title: Polygonal numbers at three

nodes.summary: For every natural number $s \ge 3$, $p_s(2) = s$, where $p_s(n)$ is the $n$-th $s$-gonal number.
nodes.title: Polygonal numbers at two

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$, the $n$-th pentagonal number is $p_5(n) = \frac{3n^2 - n}{2}$, where $p_s(n)$ is the $n$-th $s$-gonal number.
nodes.title: Closed form of the pentagonal numbers

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$, the $n$-th square number is $p_4(n) = n^2$, where $p_s(n)$ is the $n$-th $s$-gonal number.
nodes.title: Square numbers as polygonal numbers

nodes.summary: For every natural number $s$, $p_s(1) = 1$, where $p_s(n)$ is the $n$-th $s$-gonal number.
nodes.title: Polygonal numbers at one

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$, the $n$-th hexagonal number is $p_6(n) = 2n^2 - n$, where $p_s(n)$ is the $n$-th $s$-gonal number.
nodes.title: Closed form of the hexagonal numbers

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$, the $n$-th triangular number is $p_3(n) = \frac{n(n + 1)}{2}$, where $p_s(n)$ is the $n$-th $s$-gonal number.
nodes.title: Closed form of the triangular numbers

nodes.summary: For every natural number $s$, $p_s(0) = 0$, where $p_s(n)$ is the $n$-th $s$-gonal number.
nodes.title: Polygonal numbers at zero

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $s$ and $n$, the $n$-th $s$-gonal number is $p_s(n) = (s - 2)\binom{n}{2} + n$, where $s - 2$ is truncated subtraction of natural numbers (so it is $0$ when $s < 2$).
nodes.title: Polygonal numbers

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
